name: Anchor Group
definition: A subgroup of 3 isotropic categories (4-6, 6-3, 8) where face patterns require simultaneous evaluation of all neighboring expanded cubes. An anchor point is introduced to decouple interactions and lower complexity.
summary: The Anchor Group is a DCx subgroup that uses an anchor point to decouple neighbor interactions, simplifying complex mesh generation and preventing non-manifold structures.
